messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — we need a tight latency vs cost narrative + two chart variants for the launch post and webinar deck. Deadline: Thu EOD. Who can take the visuals?
Sam Patel: I can mock the charts. Which slices should I show? broad model comparison or app-specific (chat/search)?
Jia Li: Recommend both: (A) model-level curve: p95 latency vs $/1k tokens (hosted vs quantized private) and (B) app slice: effective end-to-end latency for a 2‑turn chat at 512 tokens, with cost per session.
Liam O'Connor: Messaging question — do we lead with "predictable tail latency" or "cost-per-inference savings"? Different CTAs for each. My vote: lead with predictable latency for product-first customers, cost for platform/ops audience.
Ana Gutierrez: For inbound routing: enterprise leads -> sales form + demo flow; PLG leads -> docs + credit signup; webinar signups -> nurture sequence (2 follow-ups + benchmark whitepaper). Add UTM params.
Sam Patel: ok i'll sketch A/B visuals: Variant 1 = latency-first headline + cost inset, Variant 2 = cost-first headline w/ latency badge. Will push PNGs to the drive. Need a sample CSV of benchmark points and the preferred color palette.
Maya Chen: color palette = Redwood core (red, dark slate, warm gray). Provide sample CSV columns: model, mode, p50, p95, cost_per_1k. Jia can paste a short mock.
Jia Li: here's a tiny mock (pasteable):
```
model,mode,p50_ms,p95_ms,cost_per_1k
open-7b,hosted,40,120,0.18
redwood-8k,quantized,30,90,0.10
open-1.3b,hosted,25,80,0.06
```
Use log scale for cost axis maybe, or dual axis with clear labels. Call out canary fallback: "auto-fallback to smaller variant at high load" as a footnote.
Liam O'Connor: Nice. For copy examples:
- Latency-first headline: "Predictable sub-100ms tails for production chat — without breaking your budget."
- Cost-first headline: "Cut token costs by up to 3x with model routing & quantization."
Pick one per channel.
Ana Gutierrez: Routing detail: add a hidden form field to tag source = "benchmark-launch" and a checkbox for "enterprise contact". Webinar registrants get whitepaper email + sales follow if role = decision maker.
Maya Chen: Owners &Due dates: Sam -> first PNG drafts by Wed noon; Jia -> full CSV + alt axis notes by Tue EOD; Ana -> routing + UTM template by Wed EOD; Liam -> two headline variants + 2-line subcopy by Wed EOD. I'll consolidate for review Thu morning.
Sam Patel: thumbs up. Quick ask: can design review be 4pm Wed?
OpsBot: Reminder: Design review room reserved (Mar 26 16:00 UTC) — calendar invite sent to participants.
Jia Li: I'll drop a short caption for the social post: "New benchmarks show how routing, batching, and quantization trade off latency and cost — practical recommendations for production."
Maya Chen: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers ping me here. :thumbsup:
Sam Patel: will do — starting mocks now.
Liam O'Connor: Happy to help tweak messaging after visuals land.
Ana Gutierrez: I'll draft the webhook payload for lead routing and share the endpoint in this thread.
Maya Chen: Thanks team — close loop Thu AM review. :rocket:
